message:
## Vulnerability Digest

The primary scan covered the normalized, deduplicated product inventory from `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. During the 24-hour window from **2026-09-30 05:10 IST to 2026-10-01 05:10 IST** (2026-09-29 23:40 UTC to 2026-09-30 23:40 UTC), eight newly published Ubuntu advisory groups were confirmed as relevant. One critical WatchGuard product-family finding also needs deployment confirmation.

### Finding 1: Ubuntu Linux kernel advisory batch

- **Affected product/component:** Ubuntu 18.04, 20.04, 22.04 and 24.04 LTS kernels, including AWS, Oracle, NVIDIA Tegra, BlueField and FIPS variants
- **Issue:** Multiple CVEs across overlapping kernel advisory sets, including CVE-2026-53131, CVE-2026-53221, CVE-2026-63886, CVE-2026-63912, CVE-2026-63984, CVE-2026-72064 and many others
- **Severity:** Not stated at the advisory-set level by Canonical
- **Description:** Canonical published a coordinated set of kernel updates addressing flaws across processor, driver, filesystem, networking and virtualization subsystems; Canonical states that attackers could potentially use the issues to compromise affected systems.
- **Why relevant:** Ubuntu and Ubuntu 22.04 are explicitly present in the monitored inventory.
- **Sources:** [Canonical kernel notice index](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices?details=kernel&order=newest), [USN-8851-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8851-1), [USN-8816-3](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8816-3)

### Finding 2: Ubuntu Authen::SASL improper login validation

- **Affected product/component:** Ubuntu `libauthen-sasl-perl`, 14.04 through 26.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-86219 / USN-8858-1
- **Severity:** Not stated by Canonical
- **Description:** Improper validation of login attempts could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access; Canonical's overview also warns of a possible crash or program execution from crafted network traffic.
- **Why relevant:** The affected package is distributed for the Ubuntu releases in the monitored product family, including Ubuntu 22.04.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8858-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8858-1)

### Finding 3: ImageMagick image-processing vulnerabilities

- **Affected product/component:** ImageMagick on Ubuntu 14.04 through 26.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-56367, CVE-2026-93586, CVE-2026-93587, CVE-2026-93588, CVE-2026-93589 and CVE-2026-93590 / USN-8859-1
- **Severity:** Not stated by Canonical
- **Description:** Crafted images could cause denial of service, and CVE-2026-56367 may also disclose sensitive information.
- **Why relevant:** The inventory names `magick` and Ubuntu, making both the application and distribution package directly relevant.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8859-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8859-1)

### Finding 4: Kdenlive/MLT project-file command execution

- **Affected product/component:** Kdenlive and MLT on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-45184 / USN-8856-1
- **Severity:** Not stated by Canonical
- **Description:** Dangerous proxy parameters in an attacker-controlled Kdenlive project can execute arbitrary commands as the user through MLT consumer properties.
- **Why relevant:** This is an official Ubuntu package vulnerability; applicability is limited to monitored systems running Ubuntu 26.04 with Kdenlive/MLT installed.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8856-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8856-1)

### Finding 5: GVfs SFTP memory corruption and local privilege escalation

- **Affected product/component:** GVfs on Ubuntu 16.04 through 26.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-84268 and CVE-2026-88924 / USN-8845-1
- **Severity:** High (CVSS 8.8 and 7.0 respectively, per Red Hat); Canonical does not state an overall advisory severity
- **Description:** A malicious SFTP server can trigger heap corruption with possible code execution, while a local race condition in the admin backend can allow escalation to root.
- **Why relevant:** Ubuntu is monitored, including Ubuntu 22.04, and the advisory explicitly ships fixes for the affected Ubuntu releases.
- **Sources:** [Canonical USN-8845-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8845-1), [Red Hat CVE-2026-84268](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-84268), [Red Hat CVE-2026-88924](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/CVE-2026-88924)

### Finding 6: OpenStack Keystone delegated-token authorization flaws

- **Affected product/component:** OpenStack Keystone on Ubuntu 16.04 through 26.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-80182, CVE-2026-80183 and CVE-2026-80184 / USN-8854-1
- **Severity:** Not stated by Canonical
- **Description:** Authenticated attackers may create credentials that outlive delegated tokens, expose role-assignment information, or escape an intended project scope through delegated-token reauthentication.
- **Why relevant:** These are official Ubuntu package fixes; applicability depends on Keystone being installed on monitored Ubuntu hosts.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8854-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8854-1)

### Finding 7: OpenSBI denial of service

- **Affected product/component:** OpenSBI on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2025-63913 / USN-8853-1
- **Severity:** Not stated by Canonical
- **Description:** Improper validation of a counter-index mask in SBI PMU extension requests can allow an attacker to crash OpenSBI.
- **Why relevant:** The advisory explicitly affects Ubuntu 22.04, which is named in the monitored inventory; only RISC-V systems using OpenSBI are exposed.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8853-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8853-1)

### Finding 8: OpenVPN TLS-session use-after-free and remote denial of service

- **Affected product/component:** OpenVPN on Ubuntu 22.04, 24.04 and 26.04 LTS
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-84471 and CVE-2026-84732 / USN-8852-1
- **Severity:** Not stated by Canonical
- **Description:** A TLS-session use-after-free may cause a crash or arbitrary code execution, and malformed ACK retransmission handling may allow remote denial of service.
- **Why relevant:** Ubuntu 22.04 is explicitly monitored and has a fixed OpenVPN package in this advisory.
- **Source:** [Canonical USN-8852-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8852-1)

### Possible match needing review: WatchGuard Fireware OS

- **Affected product/component:** WatchGuard Fireware OS using BOVPN over TLS client configuration
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-86131
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS 9.2
- **Description:** A remote attacker controlling the peer VPN server may inject commands and obtain root execution on a connecting Firebox. Fixed releases include Fireware OS 2026.3.2, 2026.2.3, 12.12.3 and 12.5.21.
- **Why it needs review:** The inventory lists **WatchGuard Mobile VPN with SSL v12.11**, while this advisory concerns **Firebox/Fireware BOVPN over TLS**, not the Mobile VPN client itself. Confirm whether the monitored WatchGuard deployment includes an affected Firebox and configuration before treating it as directly exposed.
- **Sources:** [WatchGuard PSIRT](https://psirt.watchguard.com/CVE-2026-86131/), [SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/watchguard-patches-critical-fireware-os-code-injection-vulnerability/)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

A dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes operators, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector and SQL Interface, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB's alert feed, NVD/CVE records, GitHub advisories and CISA-oriented sources.

No credible MongoDB-family vulnerability was newly reported or materially updated inside this exact 24-hour window. Older MongoDB findings were excluded.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for the Ubuntu OpenVPN, GVfs, Authen::SASL, ImageMagick and kernel updates, with package/version applicability checked before deployment. Separately verify the WatchGuard Firebox configuration because the critical issue is product-family related but does not directly name the listed Mobile VPN client.
